title: Agree the first workflow and record contracts
done: Agree one project, provisional homes, record schemas, link meanings, check criteria, and named decision roles.

title: Create the application and versioned store
done: Start a new repository/application/database; create stable IDs and retained revisions, candidate/accepted states, and record lookup.

title: Record decisions and return work for revision
done: A simple screen records person, role, reason, disposition, and exact revision; a new revision needs a new decision.

title: Create the model-call and run-record contracts
done: Connect one available model provider; validate structured outputs and retain prompt/context/model versions, failures, and run identity.

title: Add local execution and one exchange format
done: A colleague can launch the workspace, retain records across restart, and export/reopen one agreed JSON bundle with IDs, revisions, decisions, and links.

title: Capture a transcript with passage references
done: Paste/upload one plain-text format; preserve the source revision and paragraph locators and identify repeated capture.

title: Select context and resolve questions
done: A person chooses exact context records, records questions/answers/deferrals, and sees missing required context.

title: Draft needs, then derive requirements
done: Two explicit actions produce cited structured candidates. Requirements use reviewed needs and supplied risk/task context.

title: Check drafts and review trace links
done: Check schema, required measurable fields, citation locators, and allowed link types. People revise/recheck and separately accept or reject proposed links.

title: Support independent checking and correction capture
done: A separate human opens underlying evidence, records findings and correction reasons, and then records the human disposition through the shared review path.

title: Exercise the complete source-to-evidence workflow and repair it
capabilities: CAP-06 CAP-10 CAP-11 CAP-12 CAP-13 CAP-14 CAP-18 CAP-35 CAP-38
done: Check ambiguous input, unsupported output, invalid citations, model failure, rejected links, edited decisions, and saved-record retrieval; fix defects found in the bounded examples.

title: Import reference evidence and inspect traces
done: Import one agreed record/link bundle, identify missing endpoints, and show a read-only table and record neighborhood.

title: Report a small set of defined coverage gaps
done: Apply the agreed relationships, such as need-to-requirement and requirement/control-to-test; show the rule, record revision, and missing evidence.

title: Record a change and owned follow-up
done: Record old/proposed revisions, reason, scope, and update/relink/retest tasks with owner, reason, and disposition. Reuse only the new P0/P1 components built in this estimate.

title: Traverse known links and explain consequences
done: Use one bounded traversal policy, retain explanatory paths, handle cycles, and show unavailable evidence without asserting that it has no impact.

title: Extend independent review to the whole change
done: A separate human inspects requirements, hazards, controls, tests, and labels, including supplied evidence beyond the graph. Capture findings, limits, and follow-up.

title: Exercise change-review scenarios and repair them
capabilities: CAP-15 CAP-16 CAP-17 CAP-18 CAP-14 CAP-35
done: Check a threshold change, an omitted link, a graph cycle, missing context, and revised evidence. Retrieve each finding's version, reason, owner, and disposition.
